answer.label: In short
answer.lead: White-label lead generation is the full funnel built and run by MMC for your client while you own the account: landing pages, paid campaigns, forms, CRM hand-off and follow-up. It suits B2B firms, colleges and service businesses that want enquiries, with reports showing leads and the cost to win them.

blocks.h: What a white-label lead funnel includes
paras: Leads are only valuable when someone follows them up. We build the whole chain: the offer, the page, the form, the CRM entry and the follow-up messages, then tune it using lead quality, not just volume.
See our direct lead generation service for the method, and white-label PPC for the traffic side.

stages.why: You cannot say which campaign worked, so the client cannot decide where to spend.
stages.does: Forms and calls carry a source tag into the client's CRM, and the tracking is tested before launch.

stages.why: A lead that waits goes to the next firm on the list.
stages.does: Instant replies and a follow-up sequence cover the gap, with a note for the client's sales team.

stages.why: Many leads that never convert flatter the report and sour the client.
stages.does: We agree with the client what qualified means and report that count, not only form fills.

stages.breaks: The handover to sales is vague.
stages.why: Good leads stall when no one knows who calls and what they are told.
stages.does: A simple handover rule says who follows up and what they say, written with the client.

stages.breaks: Closed deals never return to the ads.
stages.why: Campaigns keep optimising for form fills.
stages.does: Qualified and won outcomes are sent back to the ad platforms, so optimisation learns from them.
